help_body:
KC Bot — evolutionary bot for Kingdom: Classic. Controls only the king (A/D/Shift/S).

============================================================
LAUNCH PARAMETERS
============================================================

Population [pop]
  How many bots (genomes) are in one generation. Each bot plays its own episode. More = wider search and more accurate selection, but training time grows linearly. Recommended 30-80. Minimum 50 (prevents degeneration).

Rounds [rounds]
  How many generations the bot trains. Each round: all bots play an episode -> select the best -> crossover/mutation -> new generation. More rounds = better final genome. Recommended 10-25.

Episode, sec [episode]
  Length of one episode in seconds at 1x speed. The bot must score as many points as it can. Short episode = fast training, but the bot does not have time to develop. Recommended 20-40.

Increment, sec [episode_increment]
  How many seconds the episode grows each next round. Gradually increases difficulty: short episodes first, longer later. Recommended 3-10. 0 = fixed length.

Speed [speed]
  Game speed: 1x, 2x, 3x. Recommended 3.0. At 4x and above the game breaks (timings).

Top (elitism fraction) [top_percent]
  Share of the best bots carried to the next generation unchanged (elitism). 0.1 = the best 10% are kept. The other 90% are crossover/mutation. Recommended 0.1-0.25.

Extra (command line / evo.py):
  --elite-window N  Elite genome smoothing window (default 3).
  --crossover-rate  Crossover probability (default 0.5).
  --mut-strength    Initial mutation strength (default 0.15).
  --mut-decay       Mutation decay per round (default 0.9).
  --mut-min         Minimum mutation strength (default 0.03).
  --restart         Restart the game between rounds (default on).
  --no-restart      Do not restart the game.
  --baseline        Create/restore baseline and exit.
  --resetAll        Reset all data (genomes, history, baseline).
  --human-genomes   Path to human_genome_*.json (comma separated).

============================================================
HOW THE BOT WORKS
============================================================

The bot uses a genetic algorithm: each bot has a genome (net weights). Every round the bots play an episode and earn fitness (points for actions). The best genomes are selected (elitism), crossed and mutated - a new generation is created. Repeats for rounds times.

Control: the bot controls only the king (A/D/Shift/S keys). The game window is not grabbed unless necessary.
Hotkeys (handled in evo.py): F8 - pause, F9 - stop the bot, F12 - full stop.

Scoring:
  - Buildings/trees: points only on completed construction/chopping.
  - Recruitment: points only on a successful beggar recruit (recruited_beggars).
  - Death: -3000 (attacked again with no coins, or the crown carried into the portal).
  - Idle: idle=-15, no_interaction=-15.
  - Progression: multiplier 1.1, daily bonus 0.05.

Human genomes: human_genome_*.json files are loaded automatically from the project folder.
Game speed: maximum 3x (at 4x and above the game breaks).

============================================================
COMMAND LINE
============================================================

Manual training run:
  py evo.py --pop 50 --rounds 15 --episode 20 --episode-increment 5 --speed 3 --top-percent 0.1

All arguments:
  --pop N               Population (default 50)
  --rounds N            Rounds (default 15)
  --episode F           Episode length, sec (default 20.0)
  --episode-increment F Episode increment (default 5.0)
  --speed F             Game speed 1-3 (default 3.0, 4x+ breaks the game)
  --top-percent F       Elite fraction 0-1 (default 0.1)
  --elite-window N      Smoothing window (default 3)
  --crossover-rate F    Crossover (default 0.5)
  --mut-strength F      Mutation strength (default 0.15)
  --mut-decay F         Decay (default 0.9)
  --mut-min F           Min. mutation (default 0.03)
  --restart / --no-restart   Restart the game
  --baseline            Baseline mode
  --resetAll            Full reset
  --human-genomes PATH  Human genomes

============================================================
LAUNCHER (launcher.py)
============================================================

Parameters are entered in the left panel. "Default" resets them to the recommended values.
Theme: sun button in the title bar -> pick from the list, applied live.
Language: globe button -> Russian/English, localization from locales/*.json.
Help: "?" button -> this window. Search: type text, all matches are highlighted,
step through results with the ◀ ▶ buttons, the counter shows current/total.
Panels can be moved with the ← → arrows in the panel header.
Console and details can be detached into separate windows (↙ button).
Window geometry is stored in %APPDATA%/KCbot/ and restored on restart.

Game patch: on startup and when the speed changes the launcher checks whether
Assembly-CSharp.dll is patched and offers to patch it. Undo: py patcher.py --unpatch.

Logs: logs/<date>/<N> generations_<M> bot.log - not removed by cleanup.
